provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Carcassonne Complete Annotated Rules v7.3 (River, Inns & Cathedrals, Traders & Builders, The Abbot)

steps.text: Start tile (dark back) faceup in the center
River: spring tile in the center; lake tile aside; shuffle the other 10 river tiles facedown in their own stack
steps.note: Draw river tiles until gone, then place the lake and continue normally; no 180-degree river U-turns

steps.text: The normal start tile: shuffle into the river stack, or place it when the river is done
Add the 18 Inns & Cathedrals land tiles
Add the 24 Traders & Builders land tiles
Shuffle the landscape tiles facedown into several stacks within reach
Scoring board to the side; 50/100 point tiles set aside
20 trade counters (wine, grain, cloth) as a supply
Each player takes 7 meeples of a color; the 8th on 0 of the scoring board
Each player takes their big follower
Each player takes their builder and pig
Farmers stay put until the end of the game
Unfinished roads with an inn and cities with a cathedral score 0 at game end
River segments separate farms; no followers on the river itself
The youngest player starts; play is clockwise
